name: Roasted Garlic Cauliflower Mash with Gluten-Free Gravy

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE CAULIFLOWER MASH: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Cut the top ½-inch off the head of garlic, keeping the root end attached. Place garlic, cut-side up, in the center of a square of aluminum foil and drizzle with oil. Gather the edges of the foil together to create a sealed package; place in a small baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 garlic head
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until fragrant and the cloves are softened, about 35 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry cauliflower heads; separate each head into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
When the garlic is almost done, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil.
Once the water is boiling, reduce heat to medium-high, add cauliflower, and cook until very tender, 12-15 minutes. Drain and return to the pot.

Squeeze roasted garlic out of the cloves and place in a small saucepan. Add cream, butter, salt, and pepper to the pan. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz heavy whipping cream
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower is done, add the warm garlic cream to the pot. Use a hand blender to purée until smooth. (Alternatively, you can work in batches using a regular blender or food processor.) Cover with a lid to keep warm and set aside.

FOR THE GLUTEN-FREE GRAVY: Place butter in a small saucepan. Set over medium heat and stir constantly until melted. Remove from heat and pour melted butter into a small bowl. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Add arrowroot starch to the bowl with the butter. Whisk to combine the slurry.
Combine broth, salt, and pepper in the reserved pan. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Add the slurry to the pan in a thin steady stream, while whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking occasionally, until thickened, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and pour into a serving dish.
TO SERVE: Transfer cauliflower mash to a serving dish and serve with gravy on the side. Enjoy!
